text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The horizontal axis is here, so taking the
width of
the claw into account... Just a
little more... I need
to move it a little
more...

text_block_list.name: Arcade Employee
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry! This machine has been
acting up
lately...

text_block_list.name: Arcade Employee
text_block_list.text:
I don't think it will be fixed anytime
soon, so I'll
give you a refund.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Awww... I wanted to try out my

new-and-improved "Diamond Drop"
technique...
